title: PLEASE READ!
summary: Read to learn a combination for a Reithwin Tollhouse safe.

fields.Access: Second-floor note next to the safe, passively noticed on DC 18 Perception. Its combination bypasses the safe’s DC 30 Sleight of Hand lock. This is a separate safe from the jammed door elsewhere in the tollhouse.
fields.Base value: 14 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
